Answer: C
Reason: Figure 1 shows right upper lobe consolidation with bulging of the horizontal fissure, a sign often associated with Klebsiella pneumonia or abscess formation. Figure 3 demonstrates progression to multiple cavitary lesions (abscesses) within the right lung. Figure 5c shows resolution of the acute process but leaves residual linear opacities and volume loss in the right upper zone, consistent with fibrosis.
